analysis.company_profile: Kraken provides a cryptocurrency exchange platform and related financial services, serving retail and institutional traders worldwide.

candidate_positioning: A senior AI/ML engineer with strong LLM, LangGraph, evaluation, and observability experience who can quickly ramp up on safety‑critical systems and lead the build of robust AI guardrails at Kraken.

team_needs.need: Define and drive technical direction for internal agent safety (reliability, security, determinism)
team_needs.evidence: Optum – built LangGraph‑based analytics system and automated evaluation pipelines for QA agents
team_needs.gap: No explicit safety‑oriented design or security hardening experience

team_needs.need: Build scalable, reproducible evaluation frameworks for LLMs and agents
team_needs.evidence: Optum – created automated evaluation and observability pipelines using LLM evaluators, quality metrics, and tracing
team_needs.gap: None significant; scale and breadth could be expanded

team_needs.need: Implement pre‑ and post‑generation guardrails and governance
team_needs.evidence: Viavi – RAG‑based Project Discovery Assistant with LangGraph orchestration
team_needs.gap: No direct guardrail or policy enforcement implementation shown

team_needs.need: AI security, auth/permissions, deep monitoring, incident response
team_needs.evidence: Data Engineer role – built Elasticsearch/Kibana observability dashboards; Optum – tracing and failure detection pipelines
team_needs.gap: No experience with auth/permissions models, AI‑specific incident response, or dedicated security tooling

team_needs.need: Verification and red‑team exercises for prompt injection and unpredictable behavior
team_needs.gap: No documented red‑team or adversarial testing experience

team_needs.need: Operate, scale, and cost‑optimize safety services on AWS
team_needs.evidence: Cloud experience with GCP, Azure, NCI; containerization with Docker/Kubernetes

project.name: Secure Autonomous Agent Evaluation Platform
project.problem: Kraken needs a unified service that evaluates internal LLM agents for safety, enforces guardrails, and provides real‑time observability while running on AWS.
project.approach: Leverage LangGraph to orchestrate agent runs, integrate LiteLLM/Pydantic‑AI for policy enforcement, store prompts/responses in a vector DB, and use AWS SageMaker endpoints for LLM inference. Implement auth/permission checks via AWS IAM + Cognito, expose a FastAPI/Django API, and push metrics to Datadog. Build automated evaluation harnesses using OpenAI Evals and Ragas, and run continuous red‑team attack simulations (prompt injection, jailbreak) in a CI pipeline. Deploy the whole stack on EKS with autoscaling, using Terraform for IaC and MLflow for experiment tracking.

requirements_not_covered: hands‑on production experience on AWS (EKS, SageMaker, IAM)
explicit implementation of LLM guardrails/governance policies
formal red‑team or adversarial testing experience
experience with specific safety frameworks (Inspect AI, Ragas, OpenAI Evals, NeMo Guardrails)
